purpose: ADD 工作流在多个专用页面中的 UX 视觉探索；图片中的人物、任务、执行、代码和验证结果均为示例，不代表已实现功能或真实运行证据。

references.title: Linear planning and monitoring
references.usage: 首图附带前文已查看的 Linear 项目元数据与依赖关系原图；后续各图以首图和事项概览为统一视觉参照。

sourceOfTruth: 现有产品和架构规范仍以仓库对应设计文档为准；这组图片是待评审的概念稿。
journey: 项目工作台 → 研发事项概览 → 方案文档 → 任务规划 → 单任务执行 → 独立评审 → 返回修复。各页展示同一事项在不同活动时刻的示例状态。

sharedPrompts.firstPage:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity desktop application UX concept for Fouc, an AI agent collaboration workbench. This is one of SIX DIFFERENT PAGES of ONE coherent UX suite, NOT six alternative designs. Production screenshot quality, professionally art-directed, precise simplified Chinese typography and refined compact controls. Target 1600 x 1000 landscape, full-bleed application pixels only; no browser address bar, wallpaper, perspective, device, presentation background or floating mockup. Date anchor 2026-11-11 Asia/Shanghai, use relative dates only.
REFERENCE DIRECTION: Linear's real product UI, especially project overview, documents and issue lists. Strong but restrained typography, alignment, compact metadata, carefully paced whitespace and very subtle material separation. The two attached prior conversation images are actual Linear product feature images: project metadata/document hierarchy and dependencies. Use them as reference for product craft and information hierarchy, NOT as edit targets, not a dark marketing canvas. The requested Fouc suite uses the existing LIGHT neutral visual system.
VISUAL SYSTEM FOR ALL SIX PAGES: #f9f9f9 system sidebar and 44px top system bar, #fff working surface, #242424 main text, #878787 secondary text, almost invisible gray dividers. General active states and primary buttons are neutral charcoal. Tiny muted green/amber/red for actual semantic states only. No colored brand theme, gradients, purple glow, gratuitous diagrams, KPI tiles or dashboard charts. Flat surfaces, no nesting of boxed cards. One main title around 24px, medium rather than heavy, body 14px, metadata 12px. Chinese Inter/Noto Sans SC-like font, regular strokes. Hairline dividers, 6px control radius, 30-32px buttons, restrained 16px main working surface outer corner. Give headings breathing space without making body type huge. Correct Chinese text, no gibberish, oversized bold headings, icon soup, inexplicable badges or excessive instructional prose.
FIXED SHARED SHELL: left sidebar 240px wide from x0 to240, y0 to1000. Project dropdown at top reads "Fouc 项目" and collapse control, no separate logo or brand masthead. Global navigation at y82 onward: "新对话", "工作台" selected in flat #efefef row, "任务", "成员", "资产", "智能体". Small neutral official Font Awesome Solid-like icons; simple outline chevrons/more/close controls. Below a fine divider, section "频道" with "研发讨论". Lower section "最近" with "项目成员邀请", "连接器权限说明", "任务批量移动". Bottom fixed entries "社区", "连接器", and user "林悦" with a 24px portrait and small settings icon. All global navigation active colors remain grayscale.
Above main content x240..1600 a quiet 44px system bar: back and forward arrows left; one compact 32px high page tab with close x and plus beside it; small global search, notification and window controls at far right. Main white work surface begins below bar, fine edge, outer 16px corners, extends to right/bottom edge. Preserve this shell for the whole suite. No second application sidebar. No 10-stage horizontal stepper, stage rail or permanent chat panel. ADD is a flexible workflow behind the pages, never ten mandatory columns. The user explicitly rejected cramming every activity, artifact, chat and gate on a single screen. Every page in this suite must be visually and functionally focused.
sharedPrompts.subsequentPages:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE high-fidelity Fouc desktop application page in a coherent SIX-PAGE UX suite, never a collage or alternative concept. INPUT IMAGE 1 is the canonical first page of this suite and the visual master. It is a reference for the SHARED SHELL, TYPOGRAPHY, COLORS and COMPONENTS; replace the main content to create a different page. Preserve its actual pixel geometry, aspect ratio and output dimensions, left sidebar width, top system bar, exact navigation positions, avatars, gray surfaces, hairlines, icon language and control material. The reference's actual geometry is authoritative; do not reinterpret it from textual dimensions. Keep sidebar "工作台" active and all its labels/rows/footer exactly the same. Only change the top tab title and main work content. No modal overlay.
VISUAL: Precision of Linear's real project/issue/document interfaces, quiet warm-neutral light desktop UI, white content, #f9f9f9 shell, #242424 ink, muted gray metadata, charcoal primary buttons. Make body text restrained and comfortably readable, regular Chinese sans serif, one medium-weight page title, no massive headings. Flat planes with faint separators, consistent padding, minimal tiny semantic green/amber/red status only, no visual noise, nested cards, purple/blue brand themes, decorative metrics or heavy shadows. One primary action per page. No always-open chat column, no ten-stage ribbon, no second application sidebar. Every screen represents its own focused work page. All mock data refers to "Fouc 项目" and the feature "FUC-128 项目成员邀请". Current date anchor is 2026-11-11, use relative times only.
LOCAL FEATURE NAV shared by detail screens: beneath a restrained object header, five tabs "概览", "方案", "计划", "执行", "交付", using the master's same thin underline language. These are separate page destinations, not five sections expanded together. All visible UI copy simplified Chinese except proper names, IDs and filenames. Full-bleed app screenshot only, no wallpaper, device, perspective, external labels or designer presentation frame. This is a polished professional UX concept, not a rough wireframe.

pages.title: 项目工作台
pages.purpose: 选择工作事项和待处理入口
pages.prompt:
PAGE: 项目工作台 — the entry/list page, no item detail open. This frame becomes the canonical visual master for the other five.
Top system tab says "工作台".
Within work surface generous but practical 40px padding. Header "工作台" left, one small charcoal "+ 新建工作" button right.
Below a local view selector with thin dark underline: "项目工作" active, "待我处理 3", "动态". Small search icon and "筛选" at far right of same row.
A restrained single-line next-action strip beneath, about 58px high with very subtle gray surface, not a large card: tiny amber waiting indicator, "项目成员邀请的任务计划等待确认", small "查看计划" link right. Do not show the plan itself.
Main content is a beautifully typeset compact work table grouped by "进行中" and "已交付", thin row separators, no cards per item, no graphs. Columns "工作事项", "当前活动", "状态", "负责人", "更新". Wide title column, small metadata and human avatars precisely aligned.
Group 进行中 contains four 66px-high rows:
"FUC-128" small gray ID then "项目成员邀请"; current activity "任务规划"; amber status "待你确认"; avatar "林悦"; update "刚刚". Tiny subtype "特性开发" under name. First row has a very subtle neutral hover fill and small right chevron.
"FUC-131 连接器权限说明"; "详细设计"; "进行中"; "周宁"; "28 分钟前"; subtype "文档".
"FUC-135 任务批量移动"; "独立评审"; "待修复"; "陈默"; "1 小时前"; subtype "特性开发".
"FUC-138 邀请过期提示"; "需求澄清"; "待补充"; "林悦"; "2 小时前"; subtype "问题修复".
Group 已交付 contains two restrained rows:
"FUC-124 频道附件预览"; activity "集成发布"; status "已交付"; "陈默"; "昨天".
"FUC-120 成员搜索"; "知识沉淀"; "已交付"; "周宁"; "昨天".
Small bottom count "6 项工作". Leave real whitespace below. Do not fill with fake widgets, progress percentages, calendar, metrics, big avatars, or chat. The visual should feel like a meticulously designed daily-use professional desktop tool, not a grayscale wireframe.

pages.title: 研发事项概览
pages.purpose: 查看目标、进展和下一步

pages.title: 方案文档
pages.purpose: 专注文档、验收条件和段落评论
pages.prompt:
INPUT IMAGE 2 is the suite's object overview page. Preserve its object header placement, feature title, local tab geometry and alignment, while activating "方案". Actual source screenshot dimensions and shell override any approximate textual measurements.
PAGE: 方案文档编辑, a dedicated document page at the DESIGN moment of the same feature's lifecycle. Top system tab "邀请设计". Keep the same FUC-128 feature header as input2 but compact enough to give the document room; current activity metadata is "详细设计", owner 林悦. Five local tabs remain "概览 / 方案 / 计划 / 执行 / 交付", with 方案 active. Main canvas is a beautiful focused writing surface, not an overview dashboard.
Immediately below local navigation is a quiet file toolbar: tiny document icon and "邀请设计.md", muted "v3 · 草稿"; at right small history and comment icons with "评论 2", and one 30px-equivalent charcoal button "请求确认".
The document is centered in the available main work area, about 730px text width and generous side gutters. No table outline, decorative card background, file tree sidebar, huge icons or permanent chat panel. Typeset like a refined Linear project document: controlled line length, healthy paragraph rhythm, subtle section titles, regular Chinese body strokes.
Document content:
One document title "成员邀请设计", then muted byline "林悦 · Codex 协作".
Small linked source line "依据  需求说明 v2 · 特性边界 v1".
Section "目标与范围", two concise sentences:
"管理员发送邀请链接，受邀者确认后加入当前项目。"
"本期支持创建、接受与撤销邀请。"
Section "邀请流程", three inline numbered steps on a single compact horizontal row, not large boxes:
"1 创建邀请" → "2 成员接受" → "3 加入项目".
Section "关键规则", three simple bullet paragraphs:
"邀请默认 7 天有效，管理员可撤销。"
"过期后支持重新发送，原链接立即失效。"
"重复接受同一邀请，不会重复创建项目成员。"
The second bullet has a tiny quiet comment anchor with number "2" in the right margin, demonstrating contextual comments without opening a chat column.
Section "验收条件", three compact rows with small plain unchecked checkboxes and IDs:
"AC-01 只有项目管理员可以创建邀请"
"AC-02 过期邀请提供明确提示与重发入口"
"AC-03 重复接受返回已有加入结果".
Near bottom, small text link "关联用户故事  stories.md". Do not show task assignments, task batches, tests, approval checklists, activity ribbons, agent skills, logs or overview milestones here. The whole page should communicate a calm professional document editor for deep thinking and collaboration.
Keep exact shared master sidebar and top bar, all text accurately Chinese, no rendering as sketch or low-fi wireframe.

pages.title: 任务规划
pages.purpose: 按批次安排依赖和并行分工
pages.prompt:
INPUT IMAGE 2 is the same feature's overview page. Preserve its header and five-tab geometry; activate "计划". INPUT IMAGE 1 remains the canonical shared shell and component master.
PAGE: 任务规划 — selected dependency view, focused on arranging work, NOT a dashboard or all-stage roadmap. Top system tab "任务规划". Same feature header "FUC-128 项目成员邀请", activity "任务规划", owner 林悦, ADD · 特性开发.
Local tabs 概览 / 方案 / 计划 / 执行 / 交付, 计划 active.
A single understated toolbar below local nav, on the left a view switch "批次列表" inactive / "依赖关系" active using the same neutral underline language, then small "6 项任务 · 3 个批次". At right quiet "测试计划" and the ONE small charcoal primary "确认计划". Keep control heights and visual weight consistent with input1.
Main body: a spacious beautifully drawn light dependency canvas. Near-white fine dot-grid ONLY if almost invisible; mostly white. No internal app sidebar or node library. It is a planning view for the six tasks, not a complex workflow builder. 3 left-to-right batch columns with subtle headers:
"第一批 · 明确契约"
"第二批 · 并行实现"
"第三批 · 评审与交付".
Draw exactly SIX restrained white nodes with hairline gray borders and 8px corner radii, about 235px wide, clear compact title and one small avatar/role line. Shapes must look like the same polished app components, not infographic boxes, giant rounded cards or a hand-drawn chart.
Column1 around middle height: node
"T-01" small gray ID,
"确认邀请接口与约束",
small "架构师 · Codex",
quiet state "待确认".
Column2 contains three evenly spaced nodes in a vertical stack:
"T-02" / "实现邀请生命周期" / "后端 · Codex";
"T-03" / "邀请表单与接受页面" / "前端 · Claude Code";
"T-04" / "权限与幂等测试" / "测试 · Codex".
Column3 contains two stacked nodes:
"T-05" / "独立代码评审" / "Reviewer · Codex";
"T-06" / "集成发布与端到端验证" / "林悦 · 测试 Agent".
The three middle nodes each receive a thin graceful dependency connector from T-01. All three converge into T-05. T-05 connects down to T-06. Routing must be unambiguous and elegant, with tiny simple arrowheads and no overlapping labels. No looping arrows, fake progress percentages or neon outlines. Show a tiny understated "可并行" bracket/group cue around the three second-batch nodes. Node ID and name are not giant.
Below the canvas, one slim contextual footer: small neutral check "文件范围已分配，无重叠", quiet link "查看上下文包". Small text "确认后开始第一批任务". Keep footer subordinate; no giant approval card or expanded details.
This is one focused planning page, with a complete six-task dependency structure and enough white space to understand it. Do not include the design document, code diffs, test outputs, chat transcript, activity ribbon or release approval controls.

pages.title: 任务执行
pages.purpose: 围绕单任务运行会话和操作记录
pages.prompt:
INPUT IMAGE 2 supplies the feature header and five-tab navigation; retain the same geometry and activate "执行". INPUT IMAGE 1 remains canonical shell and style.
PAGE: 单任务执行 — a focused real work session for T-02, at a later lifecycle moment than the planning screenshot. Top system tab "任务执行". Feature header FUC-128 项目成员邀请, current activity "编码验证", owner 林悦, ADD · 特性开发. Same local tabs, 执行 active.
Below feature navigation a compact task/session header:
"T-02 实现邀请生命周期" medium size, with small bot icon and "Codex · 开发会话" metadata, tiny neutral running ring and "执行中 · 2 分 14 秒".
At far right only a quiet "任务上下文" disclosure and a small outlined "停止" control, not an approval button. No release action.
Below this, a calm mode selector "会话" active / "变更 3" / "预览" / "日志". These modes replace the content; do not show them all in parallel panes.
MAIN BODY is the selected session's continuous typographic message/tool stream, comfortable reading width around 790px, centered inside the main surface. It is the actual dedicated execution page, not a chat panel attached to a dashboard. No bubbles around every message, no internal sidebar, no fixed right column, no giant terminal.
Use a real neutral BOT glyph for Codex, distinct from the owner's human portrait. Short content:
Codex — "已读取设计 v3 和本任务上下文。本次修改邀请服务及对应测试。"
Then one grouped TOOL ACTIVITY block on a very pale neutral surface, with three 40px rows:
small check "检查项目权限边界" · "已完成";
small check "实现创建、撤销与接受邀请" · "已完成";
small running indicator "运行局部测试" · "进行中".
A small indented monospace output area inside the tool block, only 3-4 lines and not black:
"invitation.service.test.ts"
"✓ 管理员创建与撤销邀请"
"✓ 重复接受返回已有结果"
"… 正在验证过期与重新发送".
Below, a compact human message with the master's 林悦 portrait:
林悦 — "过期与重复接受要分别有用例。"
Then bot reply:
Codex — "已补齐两类用例，测试完成后会附上变更与结果。"
No long fake reasoning trace, token counters, model settings matrix, unrelated messages or claims of completed independent review.
At bottom of main reading column a docked refined composer, modest 90px height, 10px-radius single thin border with no shadow. Placeholder "补充要求，或 @Agent…". Lower left tiny referenced-document chip "邀请设计.md · v3", lower right a compact charcoal send-arrow button. No purple chat theme, giant input card or repeated global controls. The rest of the page breathes naturally.
Preserve the exact suite shell, metadata hierarchy, Chinese type, grayscale surfaces and restrained control dimensions. All information on this screen supports ONE running implementation task.

pages.title: 独立评审
pages.purpose: 浏览变更、检查问题并返回修复
pages.prompt:
INPUT IMAGE 2 supplies the feature header and five-tab navigation; retain exact geometry and activate "交付". INPUT IMAGE 1 is the canonical shell/style. This is the sixth and final distinct page of ONE coherent UX suite.
PAGE: 独立评审详情 — a focused professional code-review page at a later lifecycle moment. Top system tab "独立评审". Feature header "FUC-128 项目成员邀请", current activity "独立评审", owner 林悦, ADD · 特性开发. Same local tabs with 交付 active.
Directly below local navigation, a compact subpage selector "评审" active / "发布验证" / "资料回写". Do not show the other two subpages' contents.
Review header: "T-05 独立代码评审" medium size, small bot glyph "Reviewer · Codex · 独立会话", amber status "需修改 · 1 个问题". One small charcoal primary button at far right "返回任务修复". No approve button while issue unresolved.
A quiet evidence row underneath: "3 个变更文件" · green small check "局部测试 14/14" · "评审版本 v1". These are demo review artifacts, not dashboard metric cards.
Main review work area below uses the two panes appropriate to code review, no chat column. The LEFT pane is a narrow 215px file navigator inside the review component, not another application sidebar. Header "变更文件", three compact file rows:
"invitation.service.ts" small "+28 −6";
"invitation.routes.ts" small "+12 −2";
"invitation.service.test.ts" selected with the same neutral gray row, small "+36".
The RIGHT pane is a spacious code diff viewer. Header filename "invitation.service.test.ts", restrained "+36" semantic green. White / nearly white code surface, soft green diff lines, visible gray line numbers and professional monospace. Show about 8-10 comfortably readable lines of this demo test, not an enormous code dump:
"test(\"重复接受返回已有结果\", async () => {"
"  const first = await acceptInvite(token);"
"  const second = await acceptInvite(token);"
"  expect(first.memberId).toBe(second.memberId);"
"});"
Above and below this test a few quiet surrounding context lines and faint green inserted test lines. Keep all technical text sharp, convincing and secondary to the review workflow.
An INLINE REVIEW COMMENT attached directly below this test, inside the diff column, modest height, single light border. A tiny amber "P2" issue marker then title "补充并发接受邀请的验证用例".
Author line uses bot glyph and "Reviewer · Codex", never owner's portrait.
Comment body: "当前用例仅覆盖顺序重复接受，尚未验证并发请求。请补充同时接受邀请的场景。"
A quiet state label "未解决", and text action "关联修复任务". No nested giant cards, big avatar, decorative approval icon or automatic pass claim.
At bottom of review work area, small issue navigation "未解决 1 · 已解决 2" and a discreet "上一条 / 下一条" control. Preserve healthy whitespace rather than filling every pixel with diff.
The page shows a real review job: browse changed files, inspect a focused diff and a contextual issue, return to the linked task to fix, then review again. Do NOT add design documentation, all workflow stages, task dependency graph, execution conversation, publishing checklist or knowledge library to this screen.
Retain exact shared shell, feature header dimensions, neutral colors, refined Chinese typography and thin dividers from reference. Full-bleed desktop app only. Current date 2026-11-12 Asia/Shanghai; no visible dates needed.

validation.visualInspection: 逐图检查了页面焦点、导航一致性、示例流程、主要文案和可读性。

validation.scope: UX 概念图片与生成元数据，非前端功能实现或真实运行证据。
